code_identity: SHA256SUMS.txt identifies this code package; code_base_commit is its historical starting point, not a claim about the current checkout HEAD.

verification_scopes.release-identity: Explicit anonymous (default) or personal variant: seven pinned anchor hashes and preserved historical prompt entries; not all file bytes.
verification_scopes.checksums: Every file named by the supplied checksum manifest; not unlisted files or scientific validity.
verification_scopes.dataset: Unique IDs, QC-passed selection, source/image mappings, PNG membership and sizes; does not rerun QC or validate demographics.
verification_scopes.table2: Nine retained models, lexical endpoints, usable/refusal counts from saved reports; confidence intervals are read unless --recompute-ci is supplied.
verification_scopes.gap-sensitivity: Metric sensitivity from saved reports; not clinical adjudication.
verification_scopes.stage1-confidence: Saved diagnosis-parse sample and eligibility decision, not clinician accuracy.
verification_scopes.mitigation: Published table accounting and joint-rule outcome; not full raw-trace reanalysis.
verification_scopes.radiologist: Retained reader rows and documented file-local mapping; not new reader validation.
verification_scopes.followup: Pinned later aggregate summary and repeated-call accounting/arithmetic; does not rerun or reproduce underlying July audits.
verification_scopes.corpus-provenance: Pinned historical file inventory, exact9024 eligible IDs, original source-scope overlap and optional configured partition reconstruction; not original training image bytes or optimizer consumption.
verification_scopes.hallucination-provenance: Hash-bound saved-report arithmetic with explicit pair-ID joins and separate recorded-base comparison; authenticates neither dirty historical source nor clinical accuracy.

historical_limits: Original complete 9024-image training DICOM bytes and annotation bytes remain unavailable.
Configured partition reconstruction and partial training logs do not prove exact per-step optimizer consumption.
Historical provider snapshots and the exact dirty April20 scoring source are not authenticated.
The public generator adapter is illustrative and does not recreate the production latent-mask and CLIP-drift path.
April generation-call paths and settings do not bind runtime weight or code bytes by hash.
Source-image membership does not establish patient-level independence.
supplemental_analysis_scope: Later ML4H follow-up analyses are separate from this historical archive and require their own identified artifacts.

retained_followup_audit.scope: Byte-identical aggregate extract of retained July audits; added separately in September, not part of the historical archive. Underlying raw follow-up assets are not all supplied.
